decisions.statement: Every persona is counted from 2026-08-08 and from no day earlier.
The day named is itself left out of the days before that day.
One day alone is taken by its date whether counting began by then or not.
A date is compared as text rather than as a date.
A day with no count of its own is passed over.
A persona counted on no day is in no total rather than in a total of zero.
Nothing here turns a count into points.

definition: how many messages each persona was written over a run of days
